sources.title: Niger eVisa service endpoint
sources.officialityEvidence: Normal trusted HTTPS replay failed before connection because evisa.gouv.ne did not resolve. It cannot establish a current nationality result or issuance route.

sources.title: eVisa South Sudan
sources.publisher: South Sudan Ministry of Interior, Department of E-Visa and Immigration Service
sources.officialityEvidence: Normal trusted HTTPS replay returned HTTP 200. The portal describes electronic PDF delivery before travel but exposes no nationality eligibility schedule or terminal per-country result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Download your e-visa PDF from anywhere within 72 hours.
